title: Friend & Ranking Features Are Here!
body: Stay motivated with our new features! Adding friends allows you to see their progress and support each other. You can also check the rankings to see everyone's standings, providing a fresh spark for your daily health management. *Note: The Friend feature is accessible via the Menu, and the Ranking feature via Settings (Premium users only).

title: Special AI Credit Gift
body: Thank you for using LifeMemory! We've gifted you 3 AI credits as part of a special trial. Try using them to generate your diaries or analysis reports with AI! (Note: If you already have 8 or more credits, please use them first and then reopen this announcement to claim your gift.)

title: Enhanced Privacy Protection
body: In compliance with Google's enhanced privacy protection policies, full access to photos and videos has been removed. To allow images and videos to be displayed as they were before, we have implemented the *Media Sync Settings* feature in the settings screen.

title: Security enhancements for AI features
body: Migrated the AI engine to a more secure infrastructure (Firebase Vertex AI)

title: Full Version Released
body: The full version of the app has been officially released.
